name: sri-ganesh-bazaar
description: SEO storefront and Android commerce app for a bags-and-bulk shop

scripts.dev: node scripts/with-environment.mjs --profile frontend -- node node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs dev --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: node scripts/with-environment.mjs --profile frontend -- node node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs build
scripts.preview: node scripts/with-environment.mjs --profile frontend -- node node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs preview --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.check: node scripts/with-environment.mjs --profile frontend -- node node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs check && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test: node scripts/with-environment.mjs --profile frontend -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:db: node scripts/test-neon-database.mjs && node tests/neon-database/estimates.mjs && node tests/stock-controls/stock.mjs && node tests/product-requests/requests.mjs && node tests/fixed-units/units.mjs && node tests/admin-alerts/database.mjs && node tests/owner-analytics/database.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run test:migrations && npm run test:environment && npm run check && npm test && npm run test:db && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
